reader.requirement: At --std 85, when an OPEN (any mode) meets a file attribute conflict among the fixed file attributes the implementor validates, the OPEN must be unsuccessful (I-O status 39, §1985:VII.1.3.5 f), leaving the file unaffected and the connector not open; which attributes are validated is the implementor's choice and may vary by organization.

edition-consulted.switches: the sharing facility, CLOSE WITH LOCK and the 85 LINAGE refusal around the OPEN body; not the attribute comparison
nothing for the '39' check: FixedAttributeConflict is asked for every non-OUTPUT OPEN of a present file at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectBehavior over FileConnector.cs, SequentialConnector.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, FixedFileAttributes.cs: no edition read in FixedAttributeConflict or Conflicts
reader.witnesses-cover: part: open_fixed_attribute_conflict (accept 85, 2002) covers relative/sequential organization and record-size/type conflicts; it does not exercise OPEN I-O/EXTEND of a sequential description over a keyed store or the statement after the failed OPEN

probes.printed: SEQ I-O OVER RELATIVE 39 / READ AFTER FAILED OPEN 47 / SEQ EXTEND OVER RELATIVE 39 / SEQ INPUT OVER RELATIVE 00 / REL INPUT 00 REL READ R001 00 / VARY INPUT OVER FIXED 39 / VARY I-O OVER FIXED 39 / FIXED I-O 00 SF ABCDEFGHIJ 00
probes.expected: a validated conflict makes the OPEN unsuccessful (39), the connector is not open (READ 47), the file is unaffected (relative store still reads R001); an unvalidated attribute (sequential INPUT over a keyed store) is the implementor's latitude
RECORD VARYING description over a file whose bytes are not the implementor's length framing: conflict, 39

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR8  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3f

reader.notes: The 1985 text (as amended by X3.23b-1993) leaves the validated set to the implementor; the compiler validates what each organization's format records (keyed meta pages; the sequential varying framing and a keyed store under a writing mode), documented as DOC-A.1-129. The check precedes OpenCore so a 39 leaves the file unaffected, and it is the same code at every edition.

refuter.evidence: q2a.cob (runs/q2a-002): a RECORD VARYING OPTIONAL FD over a fixed 2x10-byte file: OPEN EXTEND 39 with the USE procedure run; WRITE after the failed OPEN 48; CLOSE after it 42; OPEN INPUT of the present optional file 39; the file then reads back unchanged under the fixed FD (ABCDEFGHIJ, KLMNOPQRST, then 10), so the unsuccessful EXTEND left it unaffected. The validated set is implementor-defined (amended GR8 text) and documented in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-129.md; the 1985 fixed-attribute list (organization, code set, record sizes, record type, physical record size, padding character, record delimiter, keys) leaves every unvalidated one inside that latitude. Citation: OK §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR8 (the text is in GR8).
